Senator for the Australian Capital Territory

positionSummary: Minister for Finance; Minister for Women; Minister for the Public Service; Minister for Government Services

sources.note: Senator for the ACT; Minister for Finance and Minister for Women from 23.5.2022; Minister for the Public Service from 1.6.2022; Minister for Government Services from 20.1.2025; Manager of Government Business in the Senate from 31.5.2022.
